verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LiveKit telephony handles inbound and outbound calls, use outbound trunks to place calls, and let agents make or receive phone calls. Nothing in the pack shows provisioning phone numbers through the platform's API; the trunk model suggests numbers may come from an external SIP provider. Missing for 10: evidence of API-based phone number provisioning, detailed inbound trunk/dispatch API docs, hands-on verification of real inbound and outbound calls.
